fields.meta_title: YouTube Landing Page Builder for Creators and Ads | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a YouTube landing page from a prompt. Four examples: a free download, a course waitlist, a video ad offer, and a live stream signup.
fields.h1: Build a YouTube Landing Page Your Videos and Ads Can Link To
fields.hero_description: Build a YouTube landing page that turns a click from a video description or an ad into a signup in a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What Happens After a Viewer Clicks Your Link
fields.features_subheading: A YouTube landing page is where a click from a video or an ad lands. Emergent builds it from one prompt.
fields.feature_1:
A page from one sentence

Describe the offer and the fields in a sentence, and Emergent builds the page, the signup form, and the table behind it. Change the headline or add a field later by prompt.
fields.feature_2:
Links tagged by video

Tag each description link with utm_content set to the video name, and every signup row keeps it. Values are case sensitive: pick one spelling per video and keep to it.
fields.feature_3:
Signups in a database you own

Each signup is a row in a database you own, with the email, the video, and the time. Send the rows to your email tool or CRM over its API, or sort them by video in the app.
fields.feature_4:
Follow-up email set in the prompt

The app emails the download link after each signup and can send a reminder before a live stream. Write each message once in the prompt and change its wording by prompt later.
fields.feature_5:
Rules that route a signup

Set a rule in the prompt, such as a seat cap or a count of bedrooms, and the app applies it to every signup: an email to the right person, or a move to a second list.
fields.feature_6:
The code is yours to keep

Export the page, its form, and its signup table to your GitHub repository on paid plans. Or keep it hosted on Emergent and edit it by prompt as the channel adds videos.

fields.tab_content_1:
Three tagged links show which video sent each signup

Burlwood Workshop links one page from three video descriptions, and each link names its video in utm_content. Viewers leave an email and get the free step stool cut list. Of last month's 1,380 signups, the step stool build drew 760, the router sled video 410, and the shop cart tour 210.
fields.tab_content_2:
Forty seats filled, and 72 wait for the next course

Kanji Lantern pins a single link first in its channel profile: a waitlist for a 40-seat spring course in beginner Japanese. Signing up takes a name, an email, and the student's level. In all, 112 people joined. The first 40 got an email holding their seat, and the other 72 went to the list for the next course.
fields.tab_content_3:
Hollis Pryor gets each move of 3 bedrooms or more

Fenwick Movers points an in-stream YouTube ad at a free estimate page. It asks for a name, a phone number, the move date, both zip codes, and the bedroom count. Last week 58 requests came in. The app emailed the 21 moves of 3 bedrooms or more to Hollis Pryor and saved the other 37 for the morning call list.
fields.tab_content_4:
One hour before the stream, all 286 get the link

Rookline Chess reviews a game live on YouTube every Thursday. Its signup page asks for an email and an optional question for the host. This week 286 viewers signed up and 94 sent a question. One hour before the stream, the app emails all 286 the stream link, and the host reads the 94 questions from one list.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a YouTube Landing Page
fields.howto_description: Follow these seven steps to plan a YouTube landing page, tag its links by video, and test it before the video goes live.
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Ask only for what the next step needs
fields.howto_step_1_des: Pick the one thing a viewer gets for clicking: a cut list, a seat on a waitlist, a free estimate. Write the headline in the words you say on camera. The page should confirm what the viewer heard, not start a new pitch.
fields.howto_step_2_des: A description link, a channel profile link, and an ad can all point at the page. A channel can show up to 14 links on its Home tab, and the first one sits near the subscribe button. Give the page that first spot.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Add utm_source=youtube to every link, plus utm_content set to a value that names the video. Keep a short list of the values you have used and copy from it. One video should never show up in the signup table under two names.
fields.howto_step_4_des: A download needs an email address and nothing more. A waitlist might add a level, and an estimate needs a date and a size. Every extra field is one more thing a viewer types on a phone before the offer arrives.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Write one prompt with the offer, the fields, the email that goes out after a signup, and any rule that sends a signup to a person. Emergent builds the page from that prompt, and each later change is one more prompt.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Open the description link on a phone, sign up with a test address, and check that the email arrives and the new row shows the right utm_content. Fix anything that breaks before the video goes public, while nobody is clicking yet.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Read signups by video every week
fields.howto_step_7_des: Sort the signup table by video once a week. A video with plenty of views and few signups points at the offer or at where you mention it. Move the spoken mention earlier or change the headline, then compare the next week.

faq_plan.q: What is a YouTube landing page?
faq_plan.a: A YouTube landing page is a page built for viewers who click through from YouTube: from a video description, a channel link, an end screen, or an ad. It makes one offer, such as a free download or a waitlist seat, and asks only for the details that offer needs.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a YouTube landing page?
faq_plan.a: Pick one offer and the video that will link to it. Then describe the page to Emergent's AI landing page builder, with the fields and the email that should follow a signup. It builds the page and its signup table, and you add the tagged link to the video description.

faq_plan.q: Can my YouTube landing page be linked from an end screen?
faq_plan.a: Only if you are in the YouTube Partner Program. YouTube's help page on end screens says that in the YouTube Partner Program, you can link to an external website. Outside the program, put the page in the video description and your channel profile links, and mention it out loud in the video.

faq_plan.q: Can one YouTube landing page take traffic from my other social profiles too?
faq_plan.a: Yes, as long as every link carries its own utm_source value. Each signup row then shows where it came from. Build a separate page when the pitch changes with the audience: a post aimed at hiring managers, for example, deserves its own linkedin landing page.

faq_plan.q: Where should a YouTube landing page link go in the video description?
faq_plan.a: Put it in the first line of the description, above timestamps and gear links, with a few words on what the click gets, such as Free step stool cut list, then the link. Say the same words in the video, near the moment the offer comes up.

faq_plan.q: What should a YouTube landing page for a video ad show?
faq_plan.a: The offer from the ad, in the same words, and a short form for the next step. In Google Ads, a final URL is the URL address of the webpage in your website that people reach after they click your ad. Set it to this page, not your homepage. The viewer then lands on the offer they saw.

faq_plan.q: Do I need a separate YouTube landing page for each ad campaign?
faq_plan.a: Not for each ad, but for each offer. Two ads that pitch the same free estimate can share one page with different utm_content values. A new offer or a new audience gets its own campaign landing page. Emergent builds each one from its own prompt.

faq_plan.q: Can a YouTube landing page take sponsor inquiries from brands?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Add a form that asks each brand for its name, the product, the budget, and the timeline, and link it from your channel profile. Each inquiry is stored in a database you own, and the app can email you every one as it arrives.

faq_plan.q: Can a YouTube landing page live at my own web address?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Point a custom domain at the page; custom domains are included in Emergent and use credits. The link in every description and ad then reads as your own address. Pick a short path for each offer, such as /cutlist, that is easy to say out loud in a video.

faq_plan.q: Can I promote affiliate products on a YouTube landing page?
faq_plan.a: It can. Build the page to list the products from a video, with a link to each one and a plain disclosure near the top that you earn a commission. Tag each link by product to see which ones get clicks. If the page exists to earn one program's commission, build an affiliate landing page instead.

plan.angle: The keyword has no top 10 in the workbook and its AlsoAsked tree drifts to YouTube's own home page, so the page wins on builder intent: four YouTube landing pages built from a prompt, each showing where the click comes from (a description link, a channel profile link, a video ad's final URL, a live stream signup) and what the app does with the signup. The FAQ covers the definition, end screen links and the Partner Program, sharing one page across profiles, where the link goes in a description, video ad pages, per-campaign pages, sponsor inquiries, custom domains and affiliate products.
